subject: community-medicine
title: Health care delivery system in India: levels, workers and norms

steps.tx: The **ANM** (female health worker) and the **male health worker** (multipurpose worker) are posted at the sub centre, with one ANM covering about 5000 in plains. The ANM provides maternal and child health care, ensures at least three antenatal visits, and supervises local dais. The **health assistant** supervises six health workers and is posted at the PHC. The **Anganwadi worker** works at village level, serving 400 to 800 people in plains and 300 to 800 in hilly areas.
steps.say: The ANM, or female health worker, and the male health worker, also called the multipurpose worker, are posted at the sub centre. The ANM provides maternal and child health care, ensures at least three antenatal visits, and supervises local dais. The health assistant supervises six health workers and is posted at the PHC. The Anganwadi worker works at village level, serving 400 to 800 people in plains and 300 to 800 in hilly areas.

steps.tx: In the urban model, the **Urban Social Health Activist** (USHA) serves 1000 to 2500 people as a link between the **Urban Primary Health Centre** and slum households. Urban health posts are typed by population: Type A under 5000, Type B 5000 to 10000, Type C 10000 to 25000 and Type D 25000 to 50000. Only Type D has a medical officer and is attached to a hospital for sterilisation, MTP and referral.

steps.tx: A PHC becomes a **first referral unit** only when it provides 24-hour delivery services, emergency obstetric care including caesarean section, newborn care, emergency care of sick children, full family planning services, safe abortion and blood storage. The **village health sanitation and nutrition committee** (VHSNC) and the **community health officer** support these services at the community level. Exam questions often test this list of FRU criteria.

steps.tx: Remember the key impact measure for ASHA performance: **reduction in infant mortality** is the impact indicator, while counts of meetings or deliveries are process or output measures. Basic kit B at the sub centre holds paracetamol, albendazole, methylergometrine and povidone iodine ointment, while kit A holds ORS, zinc and cotrimoxazole. Indian (NRHM and IPHS) norms should be used for exam answers.
